items.title: Design foundation
items.acceptance: Review documents, schemas, examples, and validation evidence before implementation.

items.title: Script compiler and semantic validator
items.acceptance: Offline validation rejects malformed references, timings, graphs, and undeclared effects.

items.title: Managed surface geometry spike
items.acceptance: Prove one explicit managed scene and overlay-only fallback with browser traces.

items.title: Clock and playback state machine
items.acceptance: Pause, seek, rates, cancellation, and state barriers preserve all stated invariants.

items.title: Target registry and geometry service
items.acceptance: Resolve current approved targets and batch measured geometry without unsafe guessing.

items.title: Camera and visual tracks
items.acceptance: Render interruption-safe camera, cursor, highlight, and annotation from one clock.

items.title: Narration and caption coordination
items.acceptance: Prepared media, captions, anchors, seeking, and autoplay failures work with measured skew.

items.title: Accessible controls and static experience
items.acceptance: Keyboard, reduced motion, transcript, focus, and exit pass manual and automated review.

items.title: Guidance, gates, and user takeover
items.acceptance: Outcome conditions, timeout recovery, and takeover preserve user intent.

items.title: Safe effects, fixtures, and checkpoints
items.acceptance: Actions are authorized, not replayed by seeks, and reconciled after uncertain outcomes.

items.title: Agent discovery and control
items.acceptance: An agent can author/validate/preview/control safely with bounded grants and revision checks.

items.title: Framework and domain adapters
items.acceptance: Plain DOM and React share core semantics; domain adapters declare real limits.

items.title: Policy and privacy foundations
items.acceptance: Data-only scripts, permissions, redaction, cancellation, and bridge boundaries fail closed.

items.title: Browser, performance, and lifecycle evidence
items.acceptance: Publish reproducible environment-specific results and honest unsupported cases.

items.title: Authoring and portable content tooling
items.acceptance: Produce canonical scripts and reviewed diffs without making the editor a core dependency.

items.title: Fixture capture and export experiment
items.acceptance: Prove a sanitized controlled capture path and label timing/codec/interactivity limits.

items.title: Collaborative playback experiment
items.acceptance: Synchronize scene intent without granting remote control or racing user-owned cameras.

items.title: Release candidate and package verification
items.acceptance: Release only after supported behavior is demonstrated and package names/licenses are checked.

items.title: Flagship demo and progressive SDK integration
items.acceptance: Retain the compelling real-DOM story while replacing the fixture prototype with the canonical SDK; validate media, accessibility, safe interaction, real agent integration and approved public deployment at their respective gates. A standalone prototype is not milestone completion.
outputs: docs/22-flagship-demo.md — creative direction and staged rollout
demo/VALIDATION.md — local evidence; no deployed site
SDK-backed demo and production media — planned
